race.description: Monix Swan Hill Horse Of The Year (Bm56) Hcp
race.comment: TENNESSEE SPIRIT (5) was comfortably accounted for when fourth last time out over 1000m at Ballarat Synthetic, beaten 4 lengths after being prominent at the corner. That followed a win at Ballarat Synthetic at the previous outing. Best figures measure up. BONFIRE JIMMY (2) finished fourth last time out over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic, beaten 3.5 lengths. Ready to run well now at peak fitness from a draw that presents the rider with options. RIDE LIKE MICHELLE (7) wasted no time getting off the mark on debut over 975m at this track three-and-a-half weeks ago. Experience this course and trip could prove crucial. SIMPLY LUSCIOUS (8) was returning from a break last time out and proved too classy, scoring by half a length over 1000m at Warracknabeal. Fitter for that last hitout and is worth following up. MEET ME HALFWAY (6) was an improver last start when returning to this track, where he has now had two starts for two placings.
